news.title: Rehab Poster Accepted at ISMAR Adjunct 2025
news.excerpt: Our research on 'Towards a Modular XR Platform for Personalized Upper Limb Rehab' has been accepted to the IEEE International Symposium on Mixed and Augmented Reality.
news.content: The Human Computer Interaction Lab at IIIT Sri City has been developing personalized therapy solutions using extended reality technologies, adaptive algorithms, and interactive rehabilitation systems.
news.author: HCI Lab Team

news.title: EEG Poster Accepted at ISMAR Adjunct 2025
news.excerpt: This study presents a comprehensive investigation of the neural correlates of locomotion in extended reality, combining high-density EEG with systematically varied environments and interaction techniques.
news.content: The study analyzes how different locomotion methods and virtual environments affect brain activity measured by EEG to better understand neural dynamics, cognitive load, and motor control during extended reality experiences. It offers insights for designing more intuitive XR locomotion interfaces and adaptive brain-driven navigation systems.
news.author: HCI Lab Team

news.title: XR Hackathon '25: Student Innovation in Extended Reality
news.excerpt: The annual XR Hackathon brings together students and researchers to develop spatial computing applications, immersive environments, and assistive technologies.
news.content: Organized by the HCI Lab at IIIT Sri City, the XR Hackathon provides an interdisciplinary platform for students to prototype extended reality solutions, collaborate with peers and research mentors, and explore novel interaction paradigms.
news.author: HCI Lab Team
